description: National Police Commission - Rules of Procedure for Public Complaint Investigation made  by the Police Commission by virtue of the Powers vested in it under Article 155FFF of the Constitution
reasoning: This gazette contains rules of procedure made by the National Police Commission under constitutional authority, establishing regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for investigating public complaints against police officers. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it creates formal procedures and regulations rather than dealing with government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
